content: On One UI 6 (Android 14) 'Install unknown apps' permission is granted per source-app (e.g., the file manager or browser used to open the APK), not device-wide, found at Settings > Security and privacy > More security settings > Install unknown apps (or Apps > Special access). One UI 6's new 'Auto Blocker' feature can additionally hard-block sideloaded installs even when the source app has the permission, requiring users to disable Auto Blocker in Settings > Security and privacy.
